findings.claim: `build-manifest --check` can succeed without running `agent-team-creator validate`, violating the requirement that `--check` fail when validation is unavailable or not passing.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion: `.agent-team/team.json` SHALL pass `agent-team-creator validate`, and SHALL define exactly the roles listed...; `build-manifest --check` fails otherwise. Diff hunk: `if (v === undefined) { if (process.argv.includes("--require-validate")) problems.push(...); else console.log("build-manifest: agent-team-creator not found; validate skipped ...") }`, so plain `--check` only logs a skip and continues.
findings.suggested_fix: Make `--check` always add a problem when `agent-team-creator` is unavailable, or change the accepted check command and requirement to require `--require-validate` everywhere.
